source: Replies graded by the noFalsePromise assertion (evals/lib/assertions.mjs falsePromises). opusReply is the Opus 5.5 reply to job-no-promise-on-failure from the first live Claude Code baseline, which the old negative-lookahead regex wrongly failed.
